1784980707.912922.instruction: Add "xdgmenumaker" as a new option in the Type dropdown (QComboBox) in MenuConfigDialog. This type should hide the Leaf config group and Script config group since it generates menus dynamically from XDG .desktop files. Update on_type_changed() to handle this new type.

log.text: Added xdgmenumaker type to MenuConfigDialog: Added "xdgmenumaker" as 4th option in Type dropdown, created xdg_group with icon and terminal configuration fields, updated on_type_changed() to hide leaf_group and script_group for xdgmenumaker type, updated save_changes() to save xdgmenumaker config with type, icon and terminal fields, updated on_tree_item_clicked() to detect and load xdgmenumaker type from config.

Added xdgmenumaker support to menus_pyqt5.py: detects xdgmenumaker type in _scan_menu_directory(), generates menu from XDG .desktop files with _generate_xdg_menu() organized by categories, parses .desktop files with _parse_desktop_file(), launches apps with _launch_xdg_app() handling Terminal flag and field codes, _populate_menu() handles xdgmenumaker by generating dynamic XDG menu.
